Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 580 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Board of Pardons and Paroles, by an undetermined amount, dependent on (1) the number of inmates that have served 15 years of their sentence and are 55 years old that would receive a parole hearing due to the provisions of this bill and (2) the number of inmates that are subsequently released and would require supervision based on the provisions of this bill. In addition, this bill could likewise reduce the obligations of the Department of Corrections, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of inmates granted parole and released from the custody of the Department of Corrections due to the provisions of this bill.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
